title: CompactProductRealizationCoreLaws
statement: Fix the finite datum $P$, ring $A$ and field $k$ of [def-pur-conventions], and the finite-Tor constructible predicate [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Use the retained bounded-below etale antecedents and specified isomorphisms [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], compact-product constructions [def-pur-compact-product-arrows], proper-support arrows [def-pur-proper-support-compact-maps], and their canonical finite-site comparisons and realization arrows [def-pur-compact-product-realization-arrows]. Define four propositions, each universally quantified over separated finite-type $k$-schemes, the indicated compactifications and retained witnesses whose antecedents satisfy the input predicate: their etale exterior product admits a bounded-below representative with an isomorphism; the realized compact exterior arrow is natural for arbitrary morphisms of the pro-etale inputs and every specified output representative; that arrow is invertible for every such representative; for each proper closed support the canonical supported witness comparison is invertible and intertwines the transported $u_Z$ with the etale $u_Z$ followed by compact comparison. These are four separate propositions, with no chosen output representative or invertibility assumption added to their inputs. Use the source-implied finiteness of the coefficient quotient recorded with [def-pur-compact-product-twist-laws]. The ordinary-site input predicate and supported coefficient unit use [def-pur-supported-class-geometry]. Form the naturality proposition first with a variable finite commutative coefficient ring, base field, and input predicate, and then specialize to this same finite datum and its recorded input predicate.
